finding.observed: Desktop session 'Repo inventory with GPT-6.1-Terra' (engine 2.1.309), started 2026-10-31 2:08:26 AM EDT, after the #47 install at 2:03:52 AM EDT. Its Claude delegated with npeer spawn and npeer wait from Bash. No np entry appeared in the footer, no pane opened, and nothing drew above the prompt.
finding.cause: Confirmed: the mod loaded (mcp__np__catalog and mcp__np__mirror in the session's tools), its bridge (pid 44671) recorded peer np1_d3901754…, and the journal holds the spawned group 36b79339… under that parent key, so the lineage carried the worker. paneBeside was called only from the np agent type's spawn path (pathA), so a CLI spawn opened nothing; #47 had removed the band and turned off the status entry on the desktop app, leaving the footer menu as the only entry. Not established: why the footer menu did not appear. No engine debug log exists for desktop sessions, and the app log records no plugin drawing, so it is unknown whether the app raised SessionMode.
